request: Implement item 9a in docs/development-plan.md, 'Concurrency in the ledger, and a note when a fan-out serialises'. Read that section first. Add average concurrency (conc) for the current phase's dispatches to the ledger line Reporting.ledger builds, and record a note on the run's log when a fan-out of several agents dispatched together ran mostly one after another. Use the timing already recorded (core/timing.py, tools/where_the_time_went.py compute conc). Add tests that fail without the change. The work is done when the project's contributing checks pass, as in README.md: python -m ruff check ., python -m mypy, python tools/check_doc_refs.py, and python -m pytest -q with coverage at or above 92%.

task.title: Extend Timing with per-phase concurrency
task.motivation: Timing.concurrency (timing.py:164-172) computes agent_seconds/busy_seconds over ALL dispatches. The ledger needs the CURRENT PHASE's conc. Timing.by_phase stores per-phase elapsed seconds but not per-phase busy or agent-seconds. Span has no phase field. A straightforward implementation would surface the run-wide concurrency, which is wrong for multi-phase runs.

plan.title: Emit serialization NOTE when fan-out runs serially
plan.action: Emit serialization NOTE when fan-out runs serially
plan.motivation: The development plan requires a note on the run's log when a fan-out of several agents dispatched together ran mostly one after another. No such logic exists. Reporting is read-only by design, so the note must be emitted from the supervisor/phases layer via session.note() or session.emit(EventType.NOTE). The note must fail closed on degenerate timing and must not interpolate untrusted phase/kind strings into the message body.

dod.statement: When a phase has >= 2 dispatches and conc < SERIALISATION_THRESHOLD, a NOTE event is emitted via session.note() or session.emit(EventType.NOTE, ...)
When a phase has < 2 dispatches or conc >= SERIALISATION_THRESHOLD, NO serialization NOTE is emitted
A named constant SERIALISATION_THRESHOLD is defined in core/timing.py or a new module with a docstring citing the plan's measurement
The note text is a fixed harness-authored sentence; phase/kind appear only as structured context fields, not spliced into the message body
No serialization note is emitted for an empty phase (busy_seconds == 0)
